items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I went to work with Peggy. I worked with Peggy, Peggy Lee for about five years

ctx.x: We had a helluva trio. And all the drummers would come around: "Where in the world did you get that drummer." I'd say, "Never mind. I got him. You keep your hands off him. He's my drummer."
Then I started working with singers more and more. I went to work with Peggy. I worked with Peggy, Peggy Lee for about five years...
Did you go on the road with her?
